note: Manual corrections to the automatic theme classification. Applied after the keyword pass; always wins.
doi: normalised DOI (lowercase, no https://doi.org/ prefix). Preferred.
title: exact title, used only when doi is blank.
themes: semicolon-separated ids, or 'none' to clear. Valid ids: teaching-practice; digital-simulation; assessment; inclusion-wellbeing; employability; transitions-voice; sustainability-global
cross: TRUE or FALSE to set the SoTL methods tag. Leave blank to keep the automatic value.
note: free text, ignored by the site.
